meta.title: KalyChain — The Public L1 Blockchain of Trust
meta.description: KalyChain is a public, EVM-compatible, carbon-neutral Layer 1 blockchain. Finality < 3s, 10,000+ TPS, fees < $0.01. Infrastructure for the real world: DeFi, the KUSD stablecoin, AI agents and a Mobile Money bridge.
meta.ogTitle: KalyChain — The Public L1 Blockchain of Trust
meta.ogDescription: Public, EVM-compatible, carbon-neutral L1 blockchain. Finality < 3s, 10,000+ TPS, fees < $0.01. DeFi, KUSD, AI agents and a Mobile Money bridge.

hero.body: The public Layer 1 blockchain built for the real economy. Fast, secure and compliant — for decentralized finance, payments and AI agents, accessible to everyone through Mobile Money.

traction.title: Already in production. Already adopted.
traction.lead: A proven network, running for more than three years, with real and continuous on-chain activity.
traction.note: Figures read live from the network and KalyScan.

why.title: A Layer 1 designed for the real world
why.lead: Three non-negotiable requirements to carry finance and payments at scale: speed, security and compliance.

benchmark.title: KalyChain vs. the major L1s
benchmark.lead: Speed, cost and compatibility — with innovations no other Layer 1 offers.
benchmark.disclaimer: Comparative data compiled from each network's public specifications — for guidance only.

ecosystem.title: A fully integrated vertical stack
ecosystem.lead: Where others only build a blockchain, KalyChain assembles a complete digital infrastructure — from Layer 1 to everyday payments.

cards.title: KalyChain L1
cards.body: The sovereign, EVM-compatible blockchain. The settlement layer for the entire ecosystem.

cards.title: KalySwap
cards.body: The DeFi super-app: DEX, NFT Vaults and KUSD, with native Mobile Money integration.

cards.title: KALYSSI
cards.body: Infrastructure for banks and institutions. 6 pillars, 20+ countries in rollout.

cards.title: KalyOS · KalyBot
cards.body: The AI agent OS that orchestrates the ecosystem. Services sold to clients, paid in KUSD.

cards.title: KUSD
cards.body: The native stablecoin. The bridge between Mobile Money and crypto — the currency of payments and AI.

cards.title: Mobile Money Bridge
cards.body: The first Mobile Money ↔ blockchain bridge. 200M+ users within reach.

tech.title: A solid, open architecture
tech.lead: Proven technical foundations for building reliable applications at scale.

cards.title: EVM compatible
cards.body: Deploy your existing Solidity contracts without rewriting them. Ethereum tooling supported.

cards.title: Hyperledger Besu
cards.body: A proven, enterprise-grade client for a robust and interoperable public network.

cards.title: Hybrid PoA / PoS consensus
cards.body: Performance and progressive decentralization combined for lasting security.

cards.title: Finality < 3s
cards.body: Near-instant confirmation, suited to payments and real-time finance.

cards.title: Native KMT token
cards.body: KMT powers network gas; gKMT carries governance voting power.

cards.title: Interoperability
cards.body: Hyperlane bridge and Mobile Money Bridge to connect assets and users.

developers.title: Built by and for the community
developers.lead: A 100% open, documented and tooled protocol. Everything you need to start building today.

programs.title: Quarterly hackathons
programs.body: Prizes per hackathon, 4 times a year. KalyBot mentoring included.

programs.title: Bug Bounty
programs.body: Per critical vulnerability. Contracts, infra, security.

developers.note: Grant programs shown for guidance — the first official grants will be announced when the program opens.

governance.title: Governed by the community
governance.lead: KalyChain is a public blockchain. Its future is decided by those who use it, build it and believe in it.

kips.title: Regional stablecoins
kips.body: Deployment of stablecoins pegged to regional currencies.

kips.title: KalySwap V4 migration
kips.body: Vault NFT architecture and POL model.

steps.title: Get gKMT
steps.body: Convert your KMT into governance tokens to gain voting power.

steps.title: Vote or propose
steps.body: Vote on proposals or create your own. A proposal needs 4% of gKMT (≈94K) voting to pass.

steps.title: Shape the future
steps.body: Your decisions set the roadmap and the treasury allocation.

roadmap.title: A clear and ambitious trajectory
roadmap.lead: Progressive milestones, from consolidating the foundations to global expansion. TVL targets shown for guidance.

cta.body: Whether you are a developer, an institution or an entrepreneur, KalyChain gives you the foundations of an open, fast digital economy that is accessible to all.
